note: Base-game bakeoff for the locked spec. Small spins are a 2-step low-symbol chain. Pay spins are a 10-connection chain plus one coin game. Fill rate is the bar-fill probability that puts 0.30 RTP into those pay spins, so a bigger pay means a rarer fill. Winner is gold-lean + steep (growth 1.58): the pay is about 3x the silver-lean pay, so the fill is about 3x rarer, and the steep curve keeps bonus cluster pays from running away as fast as growth 1.92.
